candidates.location_hint: the content containers that appear when a trigger is activated
candidates.why: they lack a landmark role and an accessible label to identify the section for screen reader users

candidates.location_hint: the interactive triggers controlling the expandable sections
candidates.why: focus management during expansion is not explicitly handled, which may leave keyboard users disoriented when new content appears

candidates.location_hint: the conditional rendering logic for the expandable panels
candidates.why: mounting and unmounting DOM nodes dynamically can sometimes cause assistive technologies to lose context or focus state unexpectedly
